processing.bpm_pair: Both cues derived from generated bpm-threshold-up pluck, measured dominant frequency 311.22 Hz; resampled to 660 and 880 Hz, 120ms notes, 60ms gap, order swapped without reversing samples. The separately generated down candidate was not used in the finished pair.
processing.zone: First 100ms of generated pulse, with 6ms attack and 15ms release fades. Exactly 100ms silence between pulses.
